data.title: Mr. Sullivan, your wife comes to buy your freedom again.
data.intro: At her very young age, Ann went missing and got adopted by the Smiths. She thought she had a lovely family. What she didn't expected was her sister should spiked her drink. As she  ran away, she happened to take Baron Sullivan, the CEO of Sullivan Group, as a gigolu and they had sex that night. Also, she had wishes to buy him his freedom. Baron was attracted by Ann's innocence and kindness. They fell in love with each other as they knew each other. At last, Ann found her biological parents, who are super rich. Eventually, Baron and Ann break through the barriers and get together, living a happy life.
data.author: heiyan

data.title: Journey to Love
data.intro: Considered a foolish country girl, she was forced to marry an irritable disabled man and lost her innocence before the wedding. She tried every trick to escape his grasp, pretending to be crazy and foolish. Despite her efforts, he smirked and said, "You can't escape. You saved me once, and now I offer myself in return."

data.title: Love Rekindled
data.intro: While Ian Shaw was slacking off at work, HR suddenly announced that a new director would be joining their department. Ian didn't think much of it, but when the new director arrived, he discovered she was none other than his first love, Seraphina Sinclair. The two were in love for four years in college, but during their senior year, Ian broke up with Seraphina, and they hadn't seen each other since. Seeing Seraphina again, Ian assumed she must resent him. To his surprise, it seems Seraphina still has feelings for him. As they reconnect through work and life, their old flame is eventually rekindled.

data.title: MY DIVORCE LAWYER IS MY HUSBAND
data.intro: Lily Blake is shocked to learn her divorce lawyer is Rex Langford, her boss and longtime secret crush. Over time, they fall in love, but both are married to others. As they plan to divorce their spouses to be together, they discover a shocking truth. They are already married to each other.
